scope: Bounded primary-source novelty guard for possible next research after measurement repair, not a systematic literature review and not a gate for current frozen runs.

sources.title: Constrained Decoding: Harmful or Beneficial? Revisiting Its Impact on LLM Performance
sources.read_scope: Abstract, introduction, related work, method assumptions and setup/results opening in primary HTML. No code or experiments reproduced.
sources.finding: Separates format, validity and reasoning constraints; compares matched prompt/output formats. The theoretical argument conditions on specified traces/answer space; do not turn it into an unconditional greedy-decoding guarantee.
sources.novelty_overlap: Generic formatting-versus-accuracy or prompt-versus-mask comparison is already studied.

sources.title: LLMs Are Biased Towards Output Formats! Systematically Evaluating and Mitigating Output Format Bias of LLMs
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract verified and full HTML accessed; no full-body or independent replication claim.
sources.finding: Studies format bias and separates task performance from format adherence.
sources.novelty_overlap: Separate terminal validity and task correctness is measurement practice, not alone a new paper claim.

sources.title: Let Me Speak Freely? A Study on the Impact of Format Restrictions on Performance of Large Language Models
sources.read_scope: Primary abstract verified and full HTML accessed; no full-body or independent replication claim.
sources.finding: Studies free-form versus restricted structured output and reasoning performance.
sources.novelty_overlap: A short-answer instruction changes the behavioral condition; an observed change alone is not sufficient novelty.

sources.title: LLMs Decide Early and Explain Later: You Can Stop Them Early
sources.read_scope: Official ACL Anthology abstract and metadata verified by Codex; full method/PDF not yet read or reproduced.
sources.finding: Studies eliciting intermediate answers from partial traces and answer-stability stopping.
sources.novelty_overlap: Generic already-decided-versus-still-explaining or forced early-answer proposal needs a different identifying claim; exact method overlap remains unverified.

Codex_inference: Treat repaired readout as enabling infrastructure. Any next paper should state a specific falsifiable causal claim beyond generic formatting/verbosity effects. This scan cannot establish novelty of a proposed new mechanism.
